payload.retro_drained: Retro DEFERRED (owner ruling, no retro now). Inbox carried whole to the post-i9 retro - not drained here. i8c reopens the abandoned i8b-phone-connect to finish in-flight work; the relevant design is INHERITED from that iteration's evidence, not from the inbox. payload.goal: The board gets a top-middle toolbar; a phone-connect icon renders a locally-encoded QR in the details pane so the owner scans to pair the phone lane - making the from-away bless testable for the first time.
payload.pulled_in:
INHERITED from the abandoned i8b-phone-connect (blessed M1 + M2 design carry over by pointer + delta):
- A top-middle board toolbar of small icons: a greyed book placeholder (until i6) and an active phone-connect icon.
- The connect action: clicking phone-connect generates the ntfy topic pair, writes ~/.se/<project>/phone.json (enabled), and renders a QR in the details pane, ENCODED LOCALLY - the topic is the credential, never sent to an external image/QR service.
- Dependency is free (se.adr-install-over-zerodep): the QR encoder is vendored or hand-rolled (~200 lines fine); one-click install is the law; a new dependency passes se.meth-dependency-ship-review at ship.
- The config-write amendment (owner-confirmed): the engine writing phone.json amends adr-phone-secret-machine-local - acceptable, topic-possession is the authenticity model.
FROM i5b + the offer-surface fix (this session): i8c runs in its OWN worktree AND now shows + blesses on the board (projectState is worktree-aware; a worktree's offer shares the project dir; Gate.bless finds the worktree instance - proven by tests/i5c-worktree-board).
payload.left_out:
- The book itself + its open action (i6 - the icon ships greyed).
- Other toolbar icons (future, per-feature).
- Non-ntfy channels.
- The i8 bless mechanics (unchanged - this only adds pairing + the QR).
- QR decoding / the inbound side (the phone app subscribes; we only ENCODE a subscribe link).
- Live owner-physical pairing: the owner scanning the real QR and blessing from away stays a RAID trigger (se.raid-phone-live-pairing), not delegated.
